condition.narrative: Schedule 2, Section I.A.1(b): The Recipient shall establish, not later than two months after the Effective Date, and thereaftermaintain, during the period of implementation of the Operation, a Steering Committee (SC) within the Ministry of Finance andNational Planning (MoFNP) with a mandate, terms of reference, functions and resources satisfactory to the Association.

Schedule 2, Section I.A.1(c): The Recipient shall establish, not later than two months after the Effective Date, and thereaftermaintain, during the period of implementation of the Operation, a Technical Committee (TC) with a mandate, terms of reference,functions and resources satisfactory to the Association.

Schedule 2, Section I.A.2(a): The Recipient shall, not later than one month after Effective Date, prepare and adopt a StakeholderEngagement Plan for the Project in form and substance satisfactory to the Association.

Schedule 2, Section I.A.2(b): The Recipient shall, not later than four months after the Effective Date, recruit an environmentalsafeguards specialist and a social safeguards specialist in ZEMA, under terms of reference and with qualifications and experiencesatisfactory to the Association.

Schedule 2, Section I.A.2(c): The Recipient shall not later than three months after the Effective Date, recruit environmental andsocial safeguards staff to the PPD within MoA, under terms of reference and with qualifications and experience satisfactory to theAssociation.

The Food Reserve Agency (FRA) traded (sold) a total of 66,100 metric tonnes (mt) of maize as of December 31, 2023. As of September 9, 2024, FRA had sold a total of 146,850 mt of Maize and purchased 128,355.97 mt bringing the total amount of trade for 2024 to 275,205.97mt. The cumulative total as of September 9, 2024 stood at 66,100 + 275,205.97 = 341,305.97. Amounts are currently being verified by the third party verification and will be reported by the end of April 2025.

title.narrative: Share of FISP budget under e-vouchers

comment.narrative: 17 Districts were migrated to e-voucher in the 2023/2024 farming season which amounted to ZMW 1,549,273,497.68 being spent on e-voucher for 221,899 beneficiaries. The e-value is estimated to be ZMW 6,981.89 representing 16.99 percent. For 2024/2025 farming season rolling out to 74 districts ongoing, amounting to ZMW 6,209,000,000 for 739,266 beneficiaries. The e-value is estimated to be ZMW 8,400.
